numpy.replacement_seam: Array shape, dtype, missingness, ordering, numeric precision and error behavior require canonical vectors before substitution.

scikit-learn.replacement_seam: Estimator identity, preprocessing, randomness, learned state, prediction shape and numeric tolerance require exact method contracts.

scipy.replacement_seam: Algorithm selection, convergence, tolerances, sparse/dense behavior and failure semantics require exact vectors and resource envelopes.

rich.replacement_seam: Rendered formatting may change, but semantic result identities and evidence must remain unchanged.

textual.replacement_seam: Interaction state, accessibility, cancellation and admitted-command boundaries require explicit compatibility tests.

pydantic.replacement_seam: Hostile carrier admission, coercion, unknown fields, error paths and serialization rules require exact compatibility policy.

pydantic-settings.replacement_seam: Precedence, defaults, secret handling, parsing and refusal behavior require explicit configuration contracts.

diskcache.replacement_seam: Cache identity, expiry, serialization, locking, eviction, corruption and invalidation semantics require bounded tests.

typer.replacement_seam: Command names, arguments, exit codes, help, validation and cancellation remain compatibility surfaces.

tree-sitter.replacement_seam: Grammar edition, error recovery, byte ranges, encoding and normalization require differential parser evidence.

tree-sitter-language-pack.replacement_seam: Bundled grammar identities and versions must be observed; language-name equality is not parser equivalence.

pathspec.replacement_seam: Pattern dialect, precedence, directory anchoring, negation and normalization require discovery golden tests.

pyarrow.replacement_seam: Schema, nullability, dictionary encoding, metadata, chunking, IPC and numeric equality require exact interchange contracts.

duckdb.replacement_seam: SQL dialect, types, ordering, transactions, resource limits, persistence and extension behavior require exact query profiles.

starlette.replacement_seam: Request identity, middleware order, streaming, disconnect, error and lifecycle semantics require protocol tests.

uvicorn.replacement_seam: Startup, shutdown, concurrency, timeout, signal, socket and worker behavior require physical occurrence evidence.

watchfiles.replacement_seam: Coalescing, ordering, overflow, rename, loss and platform behavior require occurrence-specific tests.

tree-sitter-python.replacement_seam: Grammar version, recovery and node mapping require parser differential vectors.

tree-sitter-go.replacement_seam: Grammar version, recovery and node mapping require parser differential vectors.

tree-sitter-typescript.replacement_seam: TypeScript and TSX grammar identity, recovery and node mapping require parser differential vectors.

tree-sitter-javascript.replacement_seam: Grammar version, recovery and node mapping require parser differential vectors.

tree-sitter-java.replacement_seam: Grammar version, recovery and node mapping require parser differential vectors.

tree-sitter-rust.replacement_seam: Grammar version, recovery, macro partiality and node mapping require parser differential vectors.

tree-sitter-ruby.replacement_seam: Grammar version, recovery and node mapping require parser differential vectors.

tree-sitter-c.replacement_seam: Preprocessor partiality, grammar version, recovery and node mapping require parser differential vectors.

tree-sitter-cpp.replacement_seam: Preprocessor/template partiality, grammar version, recovery and node mapping require parser differential vectors.

pytest.replacement_seam: Collection, fixtures, parametrization, skip and failure reporting affect evidence execution but not product semantics.

pytest-cov.replacement_seam: Coverage configuration and measurement scope must remain explicit; coverage is not conformance.

mypy.replacement_seam: Checker version, configuration and plugin behavior are build evidence, not semantic proof.

ruff.replacement_seam: Rule edition and formatter output are repository hygiene evidence only.

build.replacement_seam: Build frontend, backend, isolation and artifact digest must be retained for reproducible-build evidence.

twine.replacement_seam: Metadata checks and publication transport do not establish runtime qualification.

jsonschema.replacement_seam: Draft edition, format checking, reference resolution and error behavior require validator conformance vectors.
